name: Rosewood Hong Kong
positioning: Rosewood hotel on Salisbury Road in Hong Kong, with a full-floor Asaya spa and Cantonese and Indian restaurants holding MICHELIN stars
best_for: Food lovers who want many restaurants and bars under one roof
Travelers who want a city stay built around a large spa
Guests who want a base near the harbourfront, museums, metro and ferries

facts.text: The hotel's address is 18 Salisbury Road, Hong Kong.
The hotel is near the Hong Kong Museum of Art, the harbourfront promenade and K11 Musea.
The metro and ferries are close to the hotel.
The hotel's owners, the Cheng family, originally came from Shunde in mainland China.
The Legacy House is a Cantonese restaurant overlooking Victoria Harbour that celebrates the culinary traditions of Guangdong province.
CHAAT serves refined Indian cuisine inspired by India's street food and homemade classics.
Bayfare Social serves Spanish cuisine and has a terrace with a view of Victoria Harbour.
DarkSide is a cocktail parlour with rare aged spirits and a live jazz band.
BluHouse serves Italian food and donates 1% of its revenue to support underserved groups in the neighbouring community.
Suites come with personalised butler service and Manor Club access.
The spa floor also has a harbour-facing gym, an infinity pool and a Rossano Ferretti HairSpa.
The hotel's Cultural Ambassador curates bespoke itineraries, from temples and historical architecture to the local dining scene.

highlights.text: The Butterfly Room serves afternoon tea surrounded by butterfly art by Damien Hirst.
The Legacy House is a MICHELIN Guide Hong Kong Macau one-star restaurant for 2024 to 2026.
CHAAT is a MICHELIN Guide Hong Kong Macau one-star restaurant for 2022 to 2026.
Asaya, the hotel's spa by Guerlain, occupies an entire floor of the hotel.
Guests can stay overnight in an Asaya Lodge.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the ultra-luxury positioning.
WhataHotel notes limited outdoor space due to the urban setting.
